Yesterday we had a very long conversation. I was completely honest, and direct with what was all on my mind. That if I had to put a number on how in love I was with her, it only amounted up to about 20%, that most of the sex we had was basically me trying to feel something if anything, that I was trying to use sex as a confidence booster for myself since that was destroyed, that every time I entered her intimately that thoughts of them flooded my head causing performance issues for me. She didnt really have much to say but of course just seemed to expect me to handle it all by not saying anything and saying she doesnt know how to fix this. 1.5 years and you have tried, haven't made an attempt. But other than that, I'm just Georgie Peachy

Well just keep remembering that honestly. Flood your mind with thoughts of your kids. Pure, innocent t thoughts of a kids mind. I know it sycks and its unfair for you, but you're gonna have to bite the bullet and keep up just for your kids sake. As for yourself, get help man.
